$schema_note: Output of the spawn-point thumbnail refactor. Sections marked NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW require running Unity end-to-end and cannot be filled in offline. Run scripts/verify-thumbnail-spawn-fix.js after generating test games to populate the runtime sections.

Assets/Scripts/LuauGameRunner.cs.spawn_pose_recording: RecordSpawnCameraState() — fires one frame after OnStart via SpawnPointThumbnailFlow
Assets/Scripts/LuauGameRunner.cs.two_phase_flow: SpawnPointThumbnailFlow(): placeholder at +3s, final at +8s + IsLoadingComplete wait (cap 10s)
Assets/Scripts/LuauGameRunner.cs.capture_and_upload: CaptureAndUpload(): locks Camera.main pose, renders 512×288, blank-detects, retries once on blank, restores camera, encodes JPEG 80, uploads with isFinal flag
Assets/Scripts/LuauGameRunner.cs.blank_detection: IsBlankImage(): 20-pixel sample, 90% match within 0.05 RGB tolerance
Assets/Scripts/LuauGameRunner.cs.spawn_state_reset: TearDown() now sets _spawnCameraState = default; so a stale pose can't leak into the next session
Assets/Scripts/LuauGameRunner.cs.audio_silenced_on_teardown: TearDown() also calls GameAudio.StopAll() (separate fix, kept)

Assets/Scripts/Services/GameAssetLoader..loading_complete_flag: Public IsLoadingComplete bool — false at LoadAssets entry, true at the end of the URL loop. Read by SpawnPointThumbnailFlow to defer the final capture until Meshy assets are in (capped at 10 s).

api-server/src/index.ts.thumbnail_endpoint: POST /api/game/:id/thumbnail now accepts {imageBase64, isFinal}. Placeholder uploads to game-thumbnails/{id}_placeholder.jpg; final uploads to game-thumbnails/{id}.jpg. DB write rules: final always overwrites; placeholder only writes when current thumbnail_url is empty.
api-server/src/index.ts.absolute_url_fix: URL is built from req.protocol + req.get('host') so dev fallbacks resolve from Unity (previously a relative '/api/glb/...' path that Unity could not resolve).
api-server/src/index.ts.rls_jwt_forwarding: Authorization Bearer <jwt> from the Unity request is passed to sbPatch as the third arg, satisfying the forge_games UPDATE policy (created_by_user_id = auth.uid()).
api-server/src/index.ts.luau_forge_system_addition: Appended SPAWN POINT RULE block right after OBJECT PLACEMENT HEIGHT in LUAU_FORGE_SYSTEM. Per-genre framing for platformer/survival/RPG/tycoon/puzzle/racer/strategy.

blank_detection_algorithm.description: Sample evenly-spaced pixels across the image. Each sample is compared to the first sample using L1 RGB distance. If ≥ 90% of samples are within 0.05 of the first sample (ie. essentially the same color), the image is considered blank.
blank_detection_algorithm.retry_policy: On blank, wait 3 s and retry once. Second blank is logged and abandoned (no upload). The placeholder retry does not block the final capture.
expected_to_catch: captures while RT not yet bound (solid black)
captures pointed at the skybox edge (solid sky color)
captures before any objects spawn (single ambient color)
expected_to_pass_through: any scene with terrain visible (variation in ≥ 2 sample columns)
any scene with > 1 distinct mesh in frame
any scene with shadows or directional lighting

spawn_camera_state_log_format.log_line: [LuauGameRunner] Spawn camera state recorded: pos=(x,y,z) rot=(rx,ry,rz) fov=N spawn=(sx,sy,sz) game=ID preview=true|false
spawn_camera_state_log_format.where_to_read: Unity console / Player.log — captured by the editor when each forge game is opened
spawn_camera_state_log_format.description: Inspect this line for each test game to see exactly what view was captured. spawn=… is the avatar spawn position; pos/rot/fov is the camera at OnStart+1 frame, which is the pose the thumbnail uses.

test_templates._note: Fill these in by running scripts/verify-thumbnail-spawn-fix.js after generating fresh games for each template. Each entry should describe the spawn state recorded (from Unity log) and the placeholder/final thumbnail URLs and byte sizes (from Supabase + curl).

platformer.expected_view: ground level facing the first set of platforms; path ahead visible

survival.expected_view: arena center, enemies visible from all sides

adventure.expected_view: world entrance facing inward; terrain, trees, structures visible

tycoon.expected_view: main building or shop in foreground

racer.expected_view: start line facing down the track

strategy.expected_view: central command structure facing the battlefield

manual_review_checklist: [ ] Forge a platformer game from a fresh prompt; open in editor; wait 10 s; exit. Confirm placeholder visible in My Games at ~3 s, replaced by final at ~8-10 s.
[ ] Repeat for survival / adventure / tycoon / puzzle / racer / strategy.
[ ] For each, copy the [LuauGameRunner] Spawn camera state recorded… line into the test_templates section of this JSON.
[ ] For each, query Supabase: select id,title,thumbnail_url from forge_games where id = N. Confirm thumbnail_url is non-empty after final capture.
[ ] curl the final URL and confirm Content-Type: image/jpeg, dimensions 512x288.
[ ] Open each thumbnail in an image viewer and confirm the spawn point view matches the expected_view for that genre.

[ ] Confirm IsBlankImage retry message ([LuauGameRunner] Thumbnail capture blank) appears in the Unity console only when actually blank — manually rotate the editor camera off-scene during forge and re-run to verify the warning fires.
[ ] Confirm camera returns to its prior orbit position after capture (not stuck at the spawn pose).

known_limits.placeholder_in_dev: When R2 is configured but R2_DEV_PUBLIC_URL is empty (current .env state), thumbnails are uploaded to R2 but served back through this api-server's /api/glb/* fallback. URLs are absolute (http://localhost:4000/...) so they resolve from Unity, but won't work if you change ports or hostnames between runs. Set R2_DEV_PUBLIC_URL to a real CDN URL to make URLs portable.
known_limits.play_path_capture: RunGame (server-authoritative play, not editor preview) does not normally fire LuauGameRunner.RunScript on the client — capture only runs when the local Lua runner executes the game. The forge → editor → preview flow is the one that captures. Existing games never captured in the editor will stay blank in My Games until you open them once.
known_limits.asset_loading_in_this_codebase: GameAssetLoader.LoadAssets pre-loads everything before RunScript starts, so IsLoadingComplete is typically true by the time the +8 s final-capture check runs. The flag is still useful when assets are still resolving from R2 cold-start; otherwise the cap kicks in after 10 s of waiting.

verification_helper: scripts/verify-thumbnail-spawn-fix.js — run with `node scripts/verify-thumbnail-spawn-fix.js` after forging the 7 test games. It reads the most recent forge_games rows from Supabase, downloads each thumbnail_url, records dimensions and byte sizes, and writes the runtime sections back into this JSON.
